from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x, color))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            objects.append(cells)

    objects.sort(key=lambda cells: max(x for _, x, _ in cells), reverse=True)
    occupied = set()
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for cells in objects:
        shift = 0
        while True:
            nxt = shift + 1
            if any(x + nxt >= w or (y, x + nxt) in occupied for y, x, _ in cells):
                break
            shift = nxt
        for y, x, color in cells:
            occupied.add((y, x + shift))
            out[y][x + shift] = color
    return out
'''
